name: Eselt Multichannel
author: eselt

sections.description:
Sell on eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de directly from WooCommerce with Eselt – a streamlined multichannel listing solution built for WooCommerce. Eselt connects your store to the marketplaces that matter and helps you create, publish, and maintain professional listings without leaving WordPress. It also includes an AI Listing Assistant that helps you generate and refine product titles and descriptions faster.

Supported Marketplaces

  • eBay: Germany (ebay.de), Austria (ebay.at), United States (ebay.com), United Kingdom (ebay.co.uk), Australia (ebay.com.au)
  • Amazon: United States (amazon.com), Germany (amazon.de), United Kingdom (amazon.co.uk), Australia (amazon.com.au)
  • Kaufland.de
  • Otto.de

List your WooCommerce items with Eselt

  • Add WooCommerce items to eBay (DE, AT, COM, UK, AU)
  • Add WooCommerce items to Amazon (COM, DE, UK, AU)
  • Add WooCommerce items to Kaufland.de
  • Add WooCommerce items to Otto.de

Features

  1. List and edit multiple listings

    • Bulk create marketplace listings from WooCommerce products.
    • Centralized editor for titles, categories, item specifics/attributes, images, and policies per channel.
    • Quick revise/re‑publish when product details change.

  2. Templates & Profiles for faster listing

    • Reusable Templates for attributes, shipping/return/payment policies, and description layout.
    • Channel‑specific Profiles to speed up eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de launches.
    • Update a Template once and apply changes across linked listings.
    • Include eBay description templates to present clean, responsive descriptions.

  3. AI Listing Assistant

    • Draft high‑quality product titles and descriptions in minutes.
    • Optimize tone, length, and keywords per marketplace.
    • Reduce manual copywriting time while keeping brand consistency.

  4. Variations support

    • List variable products (size, color, etc.) as a single multi‑variant listing where supported.
    • List up to 100 variants in minutes.

  5. Order Management & Fulfillment

    • Import orders from eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de into WooCommerce automatically.
    • Manage all orders in one place (pick, pack, ship) from your WooCommerce backend.
    • Sync shipment tracking back to marketplaces to keep buyers informed.

  6. Real-time sync

    • Turn on LiveSync to keep product attributes, price, and inventory up to date across channels.

See Eselt in Action

Scale to Amazon Fast: Turn Your WooCommerce Products into Amazon Listings with Eselt

Boost Your Sales: Move WooCommerce Products to eBay in Seconds with Eselt

From WooCommerce/eBay/Amazon to Kaufland – The Easiest Method with Eselt

From WooCommerce to Otto.de – Sell Your Products on One of Germany’s Leading Marketplaces with Eselt

WooCommerce Integration in a Few Clicks

Step 1: Install & enable the plugin
– Install and activate the Eselt plugin in WordPress.
– The plugin verifies WooCommerce and prepares a secure connection.
– API credentials are generated automatically.

Step 2: Connect marketplaces
– Set WooCommerce as your Main Store, then connect eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de.

Step 3: Prepare listings
– Select products from WooCommerce and configure channel‑specific details (categories, item specifics/attributes, images, prices, policies).
– Use the AI Listing Assistant to propose titles and descriptions.

Step 4: Publish & sync
– Publish to eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de in bulk.
– Keep prices and inventory synchronized automatically.

Step 5: Import & fulfill orders
– Eselt pulls marketplace orders into WooCommerce in near real time.
– Fulfill from WooCommerce and send tracking updates back to marketplaces.

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or newer
  • Pretty permalinks enabled (the plugin can enable them automatically)
sections.installation:
1. Install the Eselt plugin either directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory or by uploading the plugin ZIP file through WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Open the Eselt page in the admin menu and click Connect to Eselt.
  4. Follow the steps in the Eselt app to finish connecting your store.

  • Initial release with admin UI, requirement checks, permalink setup, API key generation, and Eselt app connection.

1.0.1

  • Improved usability when user is connected to the Eselt app.

1.0.2

  • More screenshots added to plugin page, better banner resolution.

1.0.3

  • Marking new version as stable.

1.0.4

  • Add video to plugin page.

1.1.0

  • Add inventory management for products and variants to enable external marketplace sync

1.3.0

  • Added Seller Central order link for Amazon orders in WooCommerce admin.

1.3.8

  • Added optional “Return tracking number” field to the order edit screen.
